preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and all(c.isdigit() or c == '-' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input is a non-empty string consisting only of digits and hyphens.
The length of the input string does not exceed 100,000 characters.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(stdout, str) and len(stdout) == 10 and stdout[2] == '-' and stdout[5] == '-'
postconditions.description: The output is a string representing a date in the format 'dd-mm-yyyy'.
The year in the output date is between 2013 and 2015.
The month in the output date is between 1 and 12.
The day in the output date is valid for the given month and year.

postconditions.expression: count_occurrences(stdout, stdin) > count_occurrences(date, stdin) for all valid dates date != stdout
postconditions.description: The output date occurs more times in the input string than any other valid date.
